verified_by: coding agent (Claude) from the public documentation page; NOT live-tested

query.$filter: OData; documented filterable: Identifier, Name, GroupName, Description, Type, ClientVersion, ComputerId, OrganizationId, SiteId
query.include: comma list; default Tags,Updates,AssetInfo,IpAddresses,LocalIpAddresses,Disks,InstalledSoftware; 'None' = basic fields only
same sections as list; additionally accepts InstalledUpdates

GET /api/v3/assets/:id.used_for: InstalledUpdates only (not returned by the list endpoint)

GET /api/v3/sites.fields_dropped: ContactInformation (personal contact data), PSA mapping fields

GET /api/v3/groups.fields_used: Id, Name, IsActive, ParentSiteId, ParentSiteName, ParentOrganizationId, ParentOrganizationName

query.NextQueryLink: only when TotalCount > 5000; portal pages with $skip instead

GET /api/v3/devices.fields_used: Identifier (GUID, same as asset Identifier), GroupId, GroupName, SiteId, SiteName, OrganizationId, IsAgentInstalled, IsMdmEnrolled

GET /api/v3/devices/:id.fields: IsOnline, Uptime (free text), InMaintenance, ExternalIpAddress, notification counts, LocalIpAddresses, ClientVersion, GroupId, ...

GET /api/v3/devices/:id/appliedpolicies.fields: PolicyType (Device Configuration|Monitoring|Antivirus|Ransomware Detection|Patch Management), PolicyId (nullable), PolicyName (e.g. 'No Policy (Explicitly configured)')
GET /api/v3/devices/:id/appliedpolicies.rate_limit: 3600 requests per hour (documented); budgeted per sync via applied_policies_budget

GET /api/v3/patchmanagement/policies/:id.fields: Id, Name, Description, GeneralSettings, OsRules[], SoftwareRules[{ProductId, ProductName, Action}] — configuration, NOT deployment state
GET /api/v3/patchmanagement/policies/:id.stored: Name, Description, documented GeneralSettings keys (NotificationSettings dropped), OsRules, SoftwareRules{ProductId,ProductName,Action}

GET /api/v3/ratelimits/.status: docs-verified 2026-11-13; not implemented yet (VSA1-01 connection test)
GET /api/v3/ratelimits/.fields: FailedRequestRateLimits[], EndpointRateLimits[{EndpointName, Rules[{Limit, Remaining, PeriodInSeconds, ResetInSeconds}]}]

PUT /api/v3/devices/:deviceId/move.status: docs-verified WRITE route; NOT on the allowlist; disabled (VSA5, BLOCKED_APPROVAL)

asset_fields_used.Identifier: string, always included — primary source key
asset_fields_used.Name: string, always included
asset_fields_used.OrganizationId: int, always included — mapped via approved CustomerSourceMapping
asset_fields_used.Disks[].Name/System/FreePercentage/Total: section Disks (TotalValue units NOT documented — stored raw)
asset_fields_used.MemoryTotal: int, always included (units NOT documented) -- stored raw (VSA4-02)
asset_fields_used.FirewallEnabled/UacEnabled: boolean aggregates, always included -- tri-state, non-boolean -> unknown (VSA4-02)
asset_fields_used.AntivirusEnabled/AntivirusUpToDate: documented as string values (example "enabled"/"yes") -- stored verbatim (VSA4-02)

asset_fields_deliberately_dropped: EventLogs, CpuUsage, MemoryUsage (point-in-time telemetry, not inventory; never presented as live)

rate_limiting.failed_requests_per_ip: 100/minute and 2000/hour count failed (non-2xx except 503) requests — auth failures must stop immediately

errors.error_body_shape: Documented example {Data: null, Meta: {ResponseCode, ErrorMessage}}; the adapter still acts on status codes only and never stores or logs error bodies

not_established: Per-device third-party missing-patch applicability (InstalledSoftware is version inventory only)
Software architecture/channel per installation (InstalledSoftware has only Name, Publisher, Version)
Stable ordering guarantees for $skip paging; adapter uses $orderby=Identifier and verifies counts
A per-device OS update scan timestamp (scan freshness can only be approximated by collection time and LastSeenOnline)
Whether AvailableUpdates is populated for non-Windows device types (treated as not_supported unless Type == windows)
Third-party application patch applicability (AvailableUpdates is documented as OS updates)

os_update_fields.basis: documented example responses (no per-field table is published for these sections)
os_update_fields.Updates: object of integer counts by severity; example keys Critical, Important, Unspecified (section Updates)
os_update_fields.AvailableUpdates[]: UpdateId, RevisionNumber, Title, Description, KbArticle, Severity, CvssScore, CveCodes, Category, ReleaseDate — 'List of available OS updates' (section AvailableUpdates)
os_update_fields.InstalledUpdates[]: UpdateId, RevisionNumber, Title, Description, Severity, ReleaseDate, InstalledAt, InstalledByAgent — only on GET /api/v3/assets/:id with include=InstalledUpdates
os_update_fields.InstalledAt: example value '2024-01-07T00:00:00' has NO timezone; stored as raw text, never assumed UTC
os_update_fields.KbArticle on InstalledUpdates: not shown in the documented example; treated as optional

route_census.third_party_patch_status_route: NONE documented. Only patchmanagement/policies/:id and /globalrules (configuration). Third-party applicability/deployment/pending/failed/reboot state = UNVERIFIED; UI shows unavailable.
